planets.name: TOI-4559 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4559 with a 3.96-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-4559 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4559. Its orbit and size follow Mistry et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
